title: Plugin config (GET and PATCH /v1/plugins/{id}/config, POST /v1/plugins/{id}/config/restore)
description: Spec: docs/specs/agent-protocol.md §2. The config path is dotted (config.yml keys). GET takes ?path= and replies $defs/read. PATCH takes $defs/patch and replies $defs/empty. Restore has no body and replies $defs/empty. The agent snapshots on the first PATCH (ADR-0002).

value.description: A YAML-compatible value: string, number, boolean, null, list or map.
